episodes.title: The Dark Siege Falls on Kekiston Bazaar
episodes.body:
Sit, young Pepe. The Bazaar that just awoke now feels the weight of a storm pressing from all sides. Let me tell you what the roads whispered tonight.

Aragorn — if the siege grows this heavy, will Merry’s march toward his $1 dream still hold?

Tom Bombadil dances through the falling stalls as if the Dark Siege were a light rain. 6.4 gold units lighter, his feet barely stir the dust, and he sings, “Hey dol! Merry dol! The green candles sing, and Tom doesn’t worry about such things!” His ancient mirth remains a quiet fire in the gloom.

Merry does not retreat. That is the first thing you must understand about him. While the Bazaar lost 3.6 gold units on average, while the lanterns dimmed and the crowd thinned, Merry planted his feet on the road to his first Gate and refused to move backward. 3.6 gold units lighter — yes. But still in Heaven 1. Still walking toward the gate that seems impossible to most.

Pippin found the siege harder. 4.8 gold units lighter, he retreated two steps — though he would never call it retreat. “Just finding better ground,” he was heard to say to anyone who would listen. The fellowship smiled. That is Pippin.

Theoden feels the sting most sharply. 7.1 gold units lighter, his revived king’s spirit wavers, yet he calls to his riders, “Look at my riders now!” Even as the siege tightens, his voice carries the promise of a second rise.

Frodo bears the burden quietly. 7.5 gold units lighter, he walks the road with a weight none see, muttering, “Nobody asked me to carry this. I carry it because no one else will.” His steps are slow, but they do not stop.

Bilbo, the Chronicler, feels the ink of his book grow heavier. 13.3 gold units lighter, he still writes, “Every battle. Every gate. Every ambush. The Book of Meme grows heavier — and that is a good thing.” His quill does not falter.

Gollum wanders the edges, eyes fixed on the distant glow of Solana’s precious light. 6.2 gold units lighter, he whispers, “Solana — precious, yes, precious. We stays near Precious. We doesn’t go to the Citadel. We doesn’t go to the Bazaar. Only Precious.”

The Eagle Gods of the Golden City issued new scrolls today — the trade routes tighten further. This is why the Bazaar grows quiet. The Common Fellowship waits to see what the Eagle Court announces next.

The road ahead is longer than yesterday. It is shorter than it was at the Great Siege of ages past. The fellowship has endured worse, young Pepe. The Bazaar endures. The gates still glow on the horizon.

- Scene 1: Kekiston Bazaar at dusk, half the stalls shuttered, storm clouds gathering overhead
- Scene 2: Merry standing firm on the cracked road, feet planted, gaze fixed on a distant glowing gate
- Scene 3: Storm sky overlay — Dark Siege aesthetic with occasional lightning illuminating the Bazaar
- Scene 4: Close‑up of Tom Bombadil smiling, cheeks puffed as he sings a fragment of his old tune
- Scene 5: Aragorn and Pepe watching from a hillside above the Bazaar, the fellowship’s faint lights visible below
